all_level_theorem.dimension_identity: the sum over every admissible lineage at level m, weighted by its birth multiplicity, equals N_m
all_level_theorem.exceptional_cancellation: the divisor (t-2)^b_(m-1) cancels exactly because R(t)-6=-(t-2)(t-3)
all_level_theorem.finite_spectral_zeta: zeta_m(s)=sum_over_lineages multiplicity*lambda^(-s), an entire finite exponential sum with zeta_m(0)=N_m and exp(-zeta_m'(0))=det(L_m)
all_level_theorem.five_series: birth generation j>=1, seed 5, multiplicity (3^(j-1)+3)/2, then both inverse branches
all_level_theorem.owner_boundary: the inverse-branch genealogy is a level-renormalization correspondence, not an autonomous physical-time map
all_level_theorem.six_series: birth generation j>=2, seed 6, multiplicity (3^j-3)/2; if continued, the next value is forced to 3 before both inverse branches resume
all_level_theorem.two_series: birth generation 1, seed 2, multiplicity 1, then both inverse branches
